source_title: What Are Payment Processing Fees For Selling On Etsy

snippets.snippet_text: "If you accept payments through Etsy Payments, we also collect a 4% + €0.30 payment processing fee when an item is sold." (EU version; UK rate confirmed separately as 4% + £0.20)
"If you issue a refund for a sale made through Etsy Payments, your payment processing fee will be credited proportionally and applied to the refund amount."
"Note: Etsy Payments processing fees are subject to VAT. VAT will be collected and appear on the VAT invoice for sellers in required locations."
"Payment processing fees are a set rate plus a percent of the total sale price of the item. This rate and percent vary by country."
